name: network
description: Who besides the owner the box's tailnet listener serves: guests from other tailnets, each limited to view-only tools. Also publishes the artifacts share path (/s/) on Tailscale Funnel when the person turns public links on.

tips.text: Run `vyre call network.guests.check` to see who besides you the box would serve.
Guests stay off until you run `vyre call --tty network.guests.enable '{"on":true}'` on the box.
Let desk@harlowlegal.com list threads: run `vyre call --tty network.guests.add` with that login and threads.list.
Run `vyre call --tty network.guests.remove` with a guest's login to stop serving them.
Open Settings, Network in the Deck to see each guest and the tools they may call.
Share the box without worry: a guest can never approve, open Glass or act as you.
